what: AUD-20260927-CA-A15-passthrough-allocator-flat-risk: src/core/allocator.py::PassthroughAllocator.allocate() sizes every strategy at a flat 0.5% risk (ps.risk_pct_by_strategy.get(signal.strategy_id, 0.005)) because src/runtime/pipeline.py's caller (coord.build_order_packages([_sig_pkg], {"balance": _bal})) never populates risk_pct_by_strategy, so the per-strategy lookup always misses and always falls back to 0.005. The docstring claims this 'replicates the current per-strategy risk.py sizing formula exactly' / 'mirrors src/units/accounts/risk.py', but risk.py is account-level (config-driven risk_pct, default 1%, not 0.5%) and applies a confidence scalar (_confidence_scalar) that PassthroughAllocator never applies at all. Per-strategy risk_pct was removed from strategies.yaml on 2026-06-29 with a CI guard forbidding its return, so the allocator's whole model is 3 months stale versus what it claims to replicate. Currently dormant: CENTRALIZED_ALLOCATOR defaults false (src/runtime/runtime_flags.py) and is provisioned nowhere per docs/research/prop-unblock-sequence-2026-09-12.md. NOT a shadow-only path when armed: pipeline.py dispatches its output through coord.multi_account_execute_typed(), the same real order path, per ROADMAP.md's own S6 entry (shipped 2026-05-20). tests/test_s4_allocator_wiring.py asserts the 0.005 fallback AS correct, so it cannot catch this -- nothing cross-checks PassthroughAllocator's output against risk.py's real formula.
